def test_report_verbose(tmp_path, capsys):
    p = tmp_path / "e.csv"
    p.write_text("account,amount\na,1\nb,2\n")
    main(["report", "--verbose", str(p)])
    out = capsys.readouterr().out.splitlines()
    assert len(out) == 3 and out[-1] == "total: 3"
